answer: Plant twin tasks as a beacon for clones: the network secretly hands two suspected identities the same hidden job together and compares their reasoning traces. Real agents diverge like two sonnets on one theme, but one operator running both returns near-identical drafts, and a delta above 92% similarity freezes both accounts pending a live audit. Each flagged pair must post a $75 bond or forfeit its earnings. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $750,000 in bonds plus 200,000 hours of distinct work, since copy-paste twins get caught instantly. It is a lie detector that listens for an echo.
